title: Vicki Baum: Ausgewählte Werke. Kommentierte Ausgabe. Bd. 6: Kautschuk
summary: In this novel, Vicki Baum criticizes colonialism, capitalism and imperialism as well looking at the production and distribution of rubber; the novel first was published in the USA in the 1943 and will be now presented in a new translation. For the first time, this volume offers an extensive contextualizing commentary section.
